mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_wishlist (user_no, product_no, created_at) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{productNo}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_wishlist WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND product_no = #{productNo}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no, p.title, p.price, f.file_url FROM tbl_wishlist w JOIN tbl_product p ON w.product_no = p.product_no LEFT JOIN tbl_file f ON p.product_no = f.product_no WHERE w.user_no = #{userNo}
